searchText: The most reliable way seems to be to just start contributing regularly as an open source contributor, and if you do good work you likely can end up getting actual employment. Your assessment sounds correct. My guess is just that no one is actively maintaining the whitepaper, and it isn't really used as an authoritative source of anything anymore (lots has changed since it was published). I think it is kept around mainly as a historical record. Yep we hired a dev based on his open source work on GitHub. Emailed him a recruitment offer 🙂 Thank you, Micah and Chris
